# HAProxy — root-to-custom-context-push-url

root-to-custom-context with VAADIN_PUSH_URL=/VAADIN/push. The browser asks for /VAADIN/push at the public root and the prefix-adding rule forwards it to the backend's /app/VAADIN/push, so unlike the NGINX sibling no second block is needed.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

HAProxy config (`haproxy/templates/add-prefix.cfg`), mounted as
`conf.d/10-vaadin.cfg`:

```haproxy
# Proxy at /, app on the /app context: the public URL stays at the root and the
# proxy adds the prefix when forwarding. Shared by root-to-custom-context and
# root-to-custom-context-push-url, which differ only in VAADIN_PUSH_URL.
#
# The mirror image of strip-prefix.cfg, and the direction that costs the most
# behind a proxy which cannot rewrite a response: everything the backend emits
# carries a /app the browser must never see. Here two regexes are enough and
# the backend needs no environment variable beyond its context path. Compare
# traefik/http/root-to-custom-context, which gets to the same place only with a
# session cookie path property, an X-Forwarded-Prefix middleware and the
# FRAMEWORK forward-headers strategy.
frontend vaadin-in from vaadin-front
    bind :80
    http-request set-path /app%[path]
    default_backend vaadin-app

backend vaadin-app from vaadin
    http-response replace-header Location ^(https?://[^/]+)?/app(/.*) \1\2
    # Anchored on the end of the value: Tomcat writes `Path=/app`, with no
    # trailing slash, so a regex expecting `/app/` matches nothing and the
    # browser at / never sends the session cookie back. That failure is total
    # and silent — every view times out — and it looks like a missing rule
    # rather than a wrong one.
    http-response replace-header Set-Cookie (.*;\s*[Pp]ath=)/app(;.*)?$ \1/\2
    server vaadin vaadin:8080
```

The `global` section, and the two `defaults` sections this file
inherits from, come from the shared
[haproxy-base.cfg](../../haproxy-base.cfg), mounted read-only beside
it as `conf.d/00-base.cfg`. Base and scenario only parse as a pair.
